sources.boundedSourceInterpretation: L5 supports modeling real situations using discrete distributions, comparing expected frequencies, parameter interpretation and simulation. Named distributions include binomial/hypergeometric and normal approximation. This is not evidence that a formal Poisson limit is compulsory. L2/L3 supports vector geometry and scalar products in the official upper-stage curriculum, but source inclusion alone does not add missing canonical dot-product target 9460 to the actual SH Personal Curriculum.
